summary: Joint letter from ESC Region 19 school districts supporting continued and modernized E‑Rate funding. The comment urges the FCC to keep the E‑Rate program, preserve Category 1 and Category 2 support, and expand eligibility to cybersecurity services while strengthening integrity and accountability. No policy claims identified in the provided text.
